owner_feedback: Use a shared combined 60000-token allowance and approximately 20000 output tokens as nonbinding planning guidance. Detailed economic reasoning takes priority over artificial field brevity. No hosted-call or complete-package approval is supplied.
retains_path_A: Strict Path A requires independently supported prevention of the combined allowance and one-generation limit, and remains BLOCKED. Path B explicitly changes both compliance semantics and permitted visible continuation; it is not equivalent to Path A.

No schema/semantic repair, complete-answer regeneration, second independent candidate, refinement or third visible generation.
constraints_changed.combined_formula: ordinary input + cache creation + cache reads + output, including all reported continuation and failed work; do not add thinking or nested cache subcounts again
constraints_changed.boundary: Inclusive 60000-token post-hoc threshold, identical across all conditions; no separate scientific input/output ceilings or borrowing between attempts.
constraints_changed.runtime: Freeze one common supported per-response output setting and continuation configuration in the complete future package; do not inherit V003 settings or mistake CLI settings for aggregate prevention. No runtime is activated here.
constraints_changed.risk: Owner must expressly accept possible consumption beyond the combined allowance and incomplete provider observability. A timeout/process stop is a best-effort abort, not a guaranteed provider-consumption bound. No paid API or subscription overage enablement follows.

pre_dispatch_review: Freeze every exact payload/system/schema/implementation/runtime hash and inventory, tagged token estimates versus verified bounds, and a common risk policy. Missing complete-input bounds preclude a Path A claim; they must be explicitly disclosed in Path B consent, not replaced by bytes-to-token arithmetic.
accounting: Report input components, output and their combined total per attempt/condition. Reconcile available terminal/model totals and deduplicated main-loop input records. Read output from terminal/model totals, never assistant placeholder outputs; preserve thinking separately without double counting. Account for all continuation/failed work. Crashes or missing/conflicting usage remain UNKNOWN. CLI list-price estimates and independently observable attributable subscription charges are separate fields; no inferred zero cost or fee proration.
continuation_evidence: A second distinct message must follow a visible output-limit signal, retain the same model/attempt/context, and append to that attempt's unfinished response. Retain original chunks in order; exact assembly is local serialization only, with no deletion, rewrite or choice among candidates. The terminal raw text must match that assembly and the full original schema. A complete earlier candidate, changed task, unexplained extra request ID or unverified continuation is a run-stop deviation. Never launch a second parent call to finish an attempt.

stop_rules.run_stop: Combined reported usage above 60000, missing/conflicting required usage, more than two visible generations, unauthorised/unverifiable continuation, any schema/semantic repair or replacement, model/account/environment deviation, auth/rate/timeout interruption or metadata/process guard failure stops further dispatch. Preserve consumed/undispatched slots and all consumption; no automatic resume or replacement.
stop_rules.format_only_failure: A terminal malformed JSON/schema/semantic response with otherwise intact identity/environment/generation/usage may count as an ordinary failed slot and proceed once to the next frozen slot. This prospective exception to stopping on every invalid card must be explicitly approved; it never permits repair or retry.
stop_rules.comparison: A stopped/incomplete run is not a complete four-condition comparison. Continuing after any run-stop trigger requires a new owner decision and prospective design; never repair this run's history.

analysis: Use all 12 intended attempts and 24 intended card slots as denominators. Preserve/review valid, malformed, weak, repetitive, surplus and missing outputs. Report by attempt and condition all token components/combined totals, thinking details, visible generation/continuation counts, deviations, unknowns, compliant yield, formatting failures, actual effort, separately observable charges and human quality dimensions. Same allowance and continuation rules do not mean equal consumption; never equalise afterwards or rank only successful cards. Three attempts per condition support narrow descriptive conclusions, not significance, novelty, M/H or investment claims.
blinding: Same independent human attestations and partial procedural blinding; keep generator/condition/log/key metadata private until judgments finish. AI assistance is not an independent human assessment.
account_gate: A future separately authorised quiet-window validation must retain per-file metadata and PID/creation-time observations before/during/after each probe, stop on drift or concurrency, and document observational limits. No credential contents, account modifications, process termination or implied hosted permission.
